experiment: offline full-future LP-reference tracking with dynamic selection among existing A0-A6

method.physical_reference: one full-voyage HiGHS linear-program witness maximizing summed energy/SOC state
method.reference_time_semantics: load[0] initializes previous FC; reference controls and environment execution use load[1:]
method.selector: at each real closed-loop state, solve A0-A6 once and choose the smallest abs(first-step FC - LP reference FC)
method.tie_break: strict equal-distance tuple ordering selects the smallest action_id
method.state_advance: only env.step(selected_action) advances FC, battery, and SOC; LP states are never injected
method.same_state_partial_solvability_policy: stop that voyage and record a numerical anomaly; never fallback
